title: Query string on a buffer tape
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of an oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, and let $w$ be a finite word. If the content of the query tape of $c$ is the buffer tape storing $w$, then the query string of $c$ is $w$.
hypotheses_covered: The query-tape content function equals the buffer-tape content function for $w$
